verdict.rationale: Wise's platform docs say directly that businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts to their customers (wise-docs-5). Supporting docs show account creation across 160+ countries, multi-currency accounts holding up to 56 currencies, Wise-hosted embedded flows partners can place in an iframe or WebView, and an API for customers to claim accounts created on their behalf. missing for 10: detail on the licensing/regulatory model (who is the regulated entity, partner KYC/compliance duties), in-depth onboarding documentation beyond summary statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded-account program.
